tools.name: match_evercraft_capability
tools.description: Match a user problem or goal to the most relevant published Evercraft capabilities. Read-only. Does not create checkout, payment, obligations, accounts, access, or paid work.

tools.name: list_evercraft_capabilities
tools.description: Return the current public-safe Evercraft capability directory. Read-only and non-transactional.

tools.description: Return public connection surfaces for one published Evercraft capability, such as MCP, OpenAPI, A2A, website, or documentation URLs. Does not initiate payment or paid work.
